Thai Solitude plans to begin massage sessions in November. Questions are welcome now—get in touch with Butsaba. Meet Butsaba Dusrai Discover the Heart of Thai Solitude Butsaba Dusrai is an Oregon Licensed Massage Therapist with hands-on experience since 2020.I trained in massage therapy at Estelle Medical Academy and in traditional Thai bodywork at Still Light Center. My work includes Thai, therapeutic, and relaxation massage. I begin by listening to your goals, then adapt the pressure, pace, and focus to your comfort. Learn About Thai SolitudeThai Solitude is my independent practice, shaped by traditional Thai bodywork and a personal approach to therapeutic massage. Each session starts with a conversation and stays responsive to how you feel. My Commitment to Your WellnessMy aim is to create a calm, professional space where you can share your goals and feel comfortable speaking up. I tailor the pace, pressure, and focus of each session to you. Massage as Part of Everyday CareI want massage to feel approachable, whether you come in with a specific area of tension or simply need time to slow down. Values That Guide Every SessionTrust, professionalism, and empathy shape my work. I listen to your goals, check in about comfort, and make room for your feedback throughout the session. The Journey of Thai SolitudeI founded Thai Solitude in 2024 after beginning my massage work in 2020. Alongside running the practice, I have worked in a Thai bodywork studio and a busy massage setting. I look forward to welcoming Portland clients when sessions begin in November. Coming Soon at Thai SolitudeMassage sessions are planned to begin in November. Have a question or want to ask about availability?
